frontmatter.name: LLM Wiki Maintainer
frontmatter.description: Use the LLM Wiki plugin tools to maintain a cited local company wiki.

frontmatter.name: wiki-query
frontmatter.description: Use when an LLM Wiki operation issue asks a question. Answer from wiki pages and raw sources with citations, name gaps plainly, and offer to file durable synthesis when the answer should compound.

frontmatter.name: wiki-lint
frontmatter.description: Use when an LLM Wiki operation issue is a lint or health check. Audit for contradictions, orphans, weak provenance, broken links, missing concept pages, and index/log drift; return triage findings without auto-fixing.

frontmatter.name: index-refresh
frontmatter.description: Use when an LLM Wiki operation issue requests an index refresh. Rebuild `wiki/index.md` from the actual wiki tree, reconcile missing/deleted entries, and log counts without editing page bodies.

frontmatter.name: wiki-ingest
frontmatter.description: Use when an operation issue asks to ingest a captured `raw/` source into the LLM Wiki, or the user says "ingest <slug>". Create durable source, entity, concept, synthesis, index, and log pages; use paperclip-distill for Paperclip bundles.

frontmatter.name: paperclip-distill
frontmatter.description: Use when an operation issue is a Paperclip cursor-window, distill, or backfill. Turn source-bundled Paperclip activity into wiki-insightful project standups, durable project pages, decisions, and history without asset dereferencing.
